name: X-15 ballistic control stick
view: the reaction control stick on the left console from behind and right, as the pilot sees it; forward is right: the small upright grip on its three-axis housing at the left hand; moved up / down for pitch, left / right for yaw and rotated for roll
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the ballistic control stick and its housing reconstructed from the public X-15 descriptions (NASA X-15 history and reaction control system overviews, Wikipedia) and public museum photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
